description: An interactive travel atlas of places Kevin Huang has visited, shown as a map or as cards. 542 markers across 13 journeys carry 10 categories, 29 starred favorites, and eight shaded region outlines, filtered and searched from one page that remembers its state. A build step extracts the basemap from a daily Protomaps planet build and fails if any marker falls outside the tiled coverage.
name: Aephonics - Travel
